run_http_server: run a Python HTTP server on localhost:10080 that handles GET and POST requests
run_ssl_server: run the HTTP server with SSL enabled using server1.pem and server1.key credentials
test_GET_handler: test the Handler do_GET method that returns a 200 response for the /get path
test_POST_handler: test the Handler do_POST method that returns 200 when /post receives 'hello' body
review_Handler_class: review the Handler class extending BaseHTTPRequestHandler with GET and POST request handling
